latest.title: Season 11 Balance Update
latest.summary: Season 11 launch patch adjusted 29 heroes and added Nightcrawler as a new Strategist. Crowd control and Strategist survivability were cut broadly, Devil Dinosaur, Emma Frost and Doctor Strange lost tankiness, and dive/brawl Duelists gained room. The Version 20261119 follow-up was only bug fixes (e.g. Mantis Life Orbs from barriers).
latest.meta_impact:
Shorter sleeps, freezes and blinds (Mantis, Luna Snow, Cloak & Dagger, White Fox) make dives and brawls safer, so Magik, Storm and Gorr top the Duelist charts while Peni Parker stays the strongest Vanguard.

Sustain-heavy supports lost self-healing, which rewards Mantis, Ultron and Rocket Raccoon for raw output. 2-2-2 is still the dominant structure, and team-ups such as Rocket Network, Flawless Design and Ragnarok drive hero choice.

details: Axes of Ichors first three strikes 30 -> 35 damage
Divine Judgement Movement Speed and Bonus Health now persist 6s after casting without staying in the domain (removed by Wingblade Ascent)
Dual-axe form: Bonus Health per Axes hit 50 -> 55
Dual-axe form: Divine Judgement damage 12.5/s -> 15/s
changes.playstyle_impact: Ground form is more rewarding: trade with axes and use Divine Judgement as a mobile engage buff rather than a zone to sit in.
changes.meta_impact: Climbs into the A-tier Vanguard group as a brawl/dive frontliner.

details: The Big Test: removed 50 Bonus Health to nearby allies; self Bonus Health 300 -> 400
The Big Test (Upgraded): removed per-strike ally Bonus Health; self damage-to-Bonus Health ratio 1 -> 1.5
changes.playstyle_impact: The Big Test is now a selfish survival ult, so use it to stay alive while brawling rather than to shield the team.
changes.meta_impact: Still a low-tier Vanguard; the change aims to make The Big Test competitive with The Ban Hammer.

details: Savage Predation control 0.8s -> 0.6s; follow-up launch 1.5s -> 1.2s
Buddy Barrier: removed 15% Slow; duration 6s -> 4s; shield 450 -> 400
Apex Advantage Bonus Health 150% -> 125% of Bleed damage
Team-up with The Punisher: Primal Punishment cooldown 12s -> 18s
changes.playstyle_impact: Less control and less self-sustain, so pick fights more carefully and lean on teammates to secure picks.
changes.meta_impact: Drops from a dominant pick to a solid but beatable A-tier tank.

details: Shield of the Seraphim 850 -> 800; recovery 60/s -> 50/s
Team-up with Invisible Woman: bonus shield 150 -> 100; ally Bonus Health from Psionic Vortex removed; self damage-to-Bonus Health 0.5 -> 0.7
Team-up with Hulk: minimum Gamma Maelstrom energy retained 50 -> 25
changes.playstyle_impact: Shield breaks sooner, so cycle it more carefully and avoid long poke duels.
changes.meta_impact: Slips to a B-tier main tank behind brawl and dive Vanguards.

details: Mind's Aegis 400 -> 350; recovery 80/s -> 65/s
Psychic Spear sentience damage 25% Max Health -> 60 + 10% Max Health
Team-up with Luna Snow: Iced Out Diamond shield 350 -> 300
changes.playstyle_impact: Less percentage burst against tanks and a thinner barrier; play her as an off-tank rather than a tank killer.
changes.meta_impact: Falls to C tier.

details: Thornlash Wall (Flora Colossus) damage 60 -> 65
Ironwood Wall health 600 -> 550
Team-up with Mantis: Wild Wall now benefits from the Flora Colossus passive
changes.playstyle_impact: Walls are a bit easier to break but hit harder; pair with Mantis to get full value from Wild Wall.
changes.meta_impact: Mid-tier overall, but the Groot + Mantis team-up is one of the highest win-rate pairs.

details: Cyber-Web Cluster explosion damage 15 -> 12
Arachno-Mine detonation delay 0.6s -> 0.7s
changes.playstyle_impact: Slightly less splash and slower mines, but the nest-and-web zone game is unchanged.
changes.meta_impact: Remains the top S-tier Vanguard and a frequent ban.

details: Power Surge Punch first two hits 35 -> 40
Defensive Stance absorption radius 2m -> 1.2m; damage-to-Energy ratio 0.55 -> 0.6
Team-up with Gambit: Mr. & Mrs. X cooldown 30s -> 15s; kinetic explosion 5+1% -> 3+1% Max Health; ally healing 15 -> 10
changes.playstyle_impact: Hits harder up close but protects allies over a smaller area, so play closer to the frontline.
changes.meta_impact: Stays a viable A/B-tier brawl Vanguard.

details: Symbiotic Resilience base Bonus Health 100 -> 75; lost-Health scaling 110% -> 100%
Frenzied Arrival falloff now starts at 3m (was 2m) and caps at 60% at 6m (was 40%)
Dark Predation detection radius slightly increased
changes.playstyle_impact: Less emergency survivability on dives; commit with cooldowns ready and exit earlier.
changes.meta_impact: Still a playable dive tank, especially with Gorr's Hive Mind team-up.

details: Feline Fury max Fortune per cast 50 -> 75
Team-up with Black Panther: Feline Alliance Bonus Health 25 -> 50; Fortune per enemy hit 50 -> 100; Fortune cap 100 -> 200
changes.playstyle_impact: Builds Fortune faster, especially alongside Black Panther.
changes.meta_impact: Moves up slightly but remains a niche flank pick.

details: Electro-Plasma Blast 50-70 -> 55-75 damage
Team-up with Phoenix: Electro-Plasma Blast 70 -> 75
Team-up with Hawkeye: Allied Agents grants Bonus Health equal to 50% of damage dealt while Focused (max 75)
changes.playstyle_impact: Stronger secondary burst and some self-sustain with Hawkeye.
changes.meta_impact: Still a low-tier niche sniper.

details: Double-Barrel Blaster falloff starts at 10m (was 20m)
Team-up with Devil Dinosaur: one ability charge removed; Smoky Snare cooldown 15s -> 12s
changes.playstyle_impact: Must play close-to-mid range now; long-range shotgun poke is gone.
changes.meta_impact: Drops to C tier.

details: Fire Cluster projectile spread changed from random to fixed
changes.playstyle_impact: More predictable damage; aim with the fixed pattern.
changes.meta_impact: Mid-tier aerial pick; the change mostly improves consistency.

details: Spark detonation direct damage 45 -> 40; area damage 20 -> 15
Endsong Inferno shockwave applies 1 Spark stack (was 2)
changes.playstyle_impact: Less burst from Spark combos and a weaker ult, so rely more on sustained fire.
changes.meta_impact: Falls to the bottom tier of Duelists.

details: Burst Acorn 110 -> 95 damage; max falloff at 3m 70% -> 60%
Squirrel Blockade projectile speed 20-60 -> 60-90 m/s; Imprison 1.3s -> 0.8s; damage 50 -> 25
Squirrel Blockade hit now creates Acorn Rain: 30/s for 2s with 20% Slow in 5m
Mammal Bond: +100% Attack Speed for 5s, projectile speed 80 -> 150 m/s with no gravity, single acorn at 65% damage
Tail Bounce grants 25 Bonus Health
changes.playstyle_impact: Shifts from lobbing heavy acorns to a faster, flatter spam window after Mammal Bond, with Blockade used for area denial.
changes.meta_impact: Kit is more consistent but she remains a low-tier pick.

details: Galactic Legend Element Guns ammo 40 -> 50
Team-up with Human Torch: Cosmic Soul cooldown 30s -> 25s; resurrection cooldown 120s -> 105s
changes.playstyle_impact: Longer ult uptime; slightly better value from the Human Torch revive.
changes.meta_impact: B-tier; best with the Mantis Star Blossom team-up.

details: Roterstern max falloff 70% at 40m -> 65% at 30m
Roterstern spell field damage 45 -> 40
changes.playstyle_impact: Must close distance to deal full damage; less long-range poke.
changes.meta_impact: Drops to C tier.

details: Feral Leap cooldown 12s -> 15s
Last Stand bonus damage per Rage point 0.3% -> 0.2% Max Health (vs 250 HP: 150 -> 125; vs 700 HP: 330 -> 260)
changes.playstyle_impact: Fewer engages and a weaker ult against tanks, so pick targets and timing carefully.
changes.meta_impact: Falls to C tier.

details: Avatar Life Stream initial heal 95 -> 55; bounces 2 -> 4 (285 -> 275 total)
Team-up with Storm: Soaring Surge speed boost 67% -> 100%
Soul Bond ally damage boost 12% -> 8%
changes.playstyle_impact: Spread healing across more allies; pair with Storm for faster aerial rotations.
changes.meta_impact: Stays A tier, boosted by the Storm and Ultron team-ups.

details: Dagger Storm cooldown 12s -> 15s; self-heal 50/s -> 35/s; each ally or enemy hit by Veil/Terror Cape cuts its cooldown by 0.6s
Darkforce Cloak damage 80/s -> 85/s
Terror Cape Blind 1.5s -> 1s
Veil of Lightforce and Terror Cape speed 20 -> 35 m/s
Team-up with The Hood: Twilight/Void Veil now launch enemies along their path
changes.playstyle_impact: Hit people with Veil/Cape to keep Dagger Storm cycling; less self-sustain.
changes.meta_impact: Remains a low-tier Strategist.

details: Kinetic Cards outer spread 2 -> 3 degrees
Healing Hearts self-heal 30/s -> 20/s
changes.playstyle_impact: Less consistent at range and less self-sustain; stay behind the frontline.
changes.meta_impact: Low-tier Strategist.

details: Veiled Step cooldown 6s -> 8s
Psionic Vortex slow: center 50% -> 40%, edge 0% -> 20%
changes.playstyle_impact: Fewer escapes; play safer positions and use Vortex for area slow.
changes.meta_impact: Mid/low-tier Strategist.

details: Sparkle Mark detonation no longer grants allies a 20% Healing Boost
Firework Finale healing 180/s -> 190/s; outer plasmoid rotation 20 -> 25 m/s
Team-up with Blade: Vampiric Kin lifesteal 30% -> 40%
changes.playstyle_impact: Less passive healing amplification; best as a brawl healer with Blade.
changes.meta_impact: A/B tier; the Blade pairing is a recommended brawl duo.

details: Deception cooldown 15s -> 18s
Team-up with Hela: each destroyed illusion adds 1s to Doppelganger and Devious Exchange cooldowns
Team-up with Mantis: Regeneration Domain no longer grants allies a Damage Boost
changes.playstyle_impact: Fewer escapes and illusions are riskier; position carefully.
changes.meta_impact: B tier, still strong in Mantis (Vibrant Vitality) pairings.

details: Absolute Zero freeze 2.7s -> 1.5s
Team-up with White Fox: Charm removed; Spirit Fox ally healing 70 -> 80, enemy damage 35 -> 45
Team-up with Adam Warlock: Duality Dance self-heal conversion 25% -> 35%
changes.playstyle_impact: Freeze is now a short interrupt, not a kill setup; focus on healing output.
changes.meta_impact: Falls to C tier.

details: Spore Slumber sleep 3.5s -> 1.5s
Allied Inspiration Life Orb cost 1 -> 2
Nature's Favor self-heal 12.5/s -> 8/s
Life Energy Blast non-critical hits now grant 0.3 Life Orbs
changes.playstyle_impact: Sleep is now a brief peel tool; land body shots too to build Orbs for buffs.
changes.meta_impact: Despite the nerfs she sits in S tier thanks to strong team-ups (Groot, Loki, Star-Lord, Adam Warlock).

details: Repair Mode heal after passing allies 55 -> 50; continuous self-heal 30/s -> 20/s
Primary falloff now starts at 15m (was 10m), 55% at 30m (was 40% at 20m)
Jetpack Dash grants 25 Bonus Health
changes.playstyle_impact: Slightly less healing but better damage at range; dash to survive divers.
changes.meta_impact: S tier, especially with Peni Parker (Rocket Network).

details: Imperative: Firewall ally Bonus Health 40 -> 25
Firewall ally movement speed boost 20% -> 10%
changes.playstyle_impact: Firewall is a smaller save; rely on drone healing and aerial positioning.
changes.meta_impact: Still S tier, with Adam Warlock's Flawless Design among the best team-ups.

details: Spirit Sanctuary shield 200 -> 100
Spectral Surge no longer grants allies Invincibility; enemy Charm radius 0.6m -> 0.4m
Fox Form Awakening base 7s -> 8s; per Spirit Tail 1s -> 2s (max 9s -> 12s)
Awakened Claw Strike 35 -> 40; Predatory Pounce cooldown 6s -> 4s
Kumiho Unleashed can now receive ally healing; health 1200 -> 1000
changes.playstyle_impact: Less team protection, more personal fighting power in Fox Form; play her as an aggressive battle support.
changes.meta_impact: Remains low-to-mid tier; best with Iron Fist (Kumiho Palm).

details: New Strategist hero released with Season 11
Team-ups include Magik (Demon Disciple) and Rogue (Protective Siblings)
changes.playstyle_impact: Teleporting support who can rescue or reposition allies.
changes.meta_impact: Early tier lists range from A to C while players learn him.
